value.description: Name of the app to create

patches.why: The apps reference names the create body's field app_name (required; its example sends {"app_name", "org_slug"}), where the published schema names it `name` (https://docs.fly.io/machines/api/apps-resource/); Substrate sends app_name.

source.quote: Machines must be associated with a Fly App. App names must be unique.

patches.why: The volumes reference response includes host_dedication_key, absent from the published Volume schema.
